suite.name: CB Suite
suite.notes: Settings gear at the bottom left: update CB Suite itself, and a Themes page with Daylight Glass, Field Notes and Night Shift. Apply a theme to all apps or to each app on its own; open apps change straight away.

dashboard.name: CB Dashboard
dashboard.notes: Settings gear at the bottom left and a new Updates page: update CB Dashboard on its own, without CB Suite, and choose whether it checks for updates when it opens. Three new themes: Daylight Glass, Field Notes and Night Shift; CB Suite can also assign one.

requests.name: Equipment Requests - Aspire
requests.notes: Settings gear at the bottom left: update this app on its own, without CB Suite, and choose whether it checks for updates each time it opens and asks before updating. Follows the theme CB Suite assigns it (Daylight Glass, Field Notes or Night Shift).

photos.name: Property Photos - Aspire
photos.notes: Settings gear at the bottom left: update this app on its own, without CB Suite, and choose whether it checks for updates each time it opens and asks before updating. Follows the theme CB Suite assigns it (Daylight Glass, Field Notes or Night Shift).

reference.name: Reference - Aspire
reference.notes: A small release to test updating from inside the app (Settings → Updates, or the pop-up when it opens). Nothing else has changed.
